{"sample_id":"arvo_11517","fine_trace":[{"step":1,"file":"aom_dsp/x86/intrapred_avx2.c","function":"highbd_dr_prediction_z1_64xN_avx2","line":1399,"var":"above[max_base_x]","code":"a_mbase_x = _mm256_set1_epi16(above[max_base_x]);","role":"source","note":"The predictor reads the edge sample array supplied from the decoded frame context."},{"step":2,"file":"aom_dsp/x86/intrapred_avx2.c","function":"highbd_dr_prediction_z1_64xN_avx2","line":1408,"var":"base >= max_base_x","code":"if (base >= max_base_x) {","role":"root_cause","note":"The code only guards the fast fill path when the computed base reaches the last valid edge index; the later vector loads still require enough valid edge samples for the current 16-wide chunk."},{"step":3,"file":"aom_dsp/x86/intrapred_avx2.c","function":"highbd_dr_prediction_z1_64xN_avx2","line":1422,"var":"above + base + 1 + j","code":"a1_128 = _mm_loadu_si128((__m128i *)(above + base + 1 + j));","role":"sink","note":"This load can read past the end of the above-edge buffer, triggering the reported stack-buffer-overflow read."},{"step":4,"file":"av1/common/reconintra.c","function":"av1_predict_intra_block","line":1470,"var":"upsample_above","code":"upsample_above = av1_use_intra_edge_upsample(txwpx, txhpx, p_angle - 90, filt_type);","role":"intermediate","note":"Directional intra prediction selects the highbd DR path and passes the edge-upsample state into the AVX2 predictor."},{"step":5,"file":"av1/common/reconintra.c","function":"av1_predict_intra_block","line":1479,"var":"highbd_dr_predictor(dst, dst_stride, tx_size, above_row, left_col, upsample_above, upsample_left, p_angle, xd->bd);","code":"highbd_dr_predictor(dst, dst_stride, tx_size, above_row, left_col, upsample_above, upsample_left, p_angle, xd->bd);","role":"intermediate","note":"The predictor call forwards the decoded above-row buffer into the AVX2 implementation."}],` executed with exit code -1.
